configurePresets.name: distro
configurePresets.description: one preset per deploy/distros manifest, named as it, with its media options (dist.test.sh holds them equal); the builders pass the same values on their command lines

configurePresets.name: yandex-pickle
configurePresets.description: pickle's audiod (deploy/builder/device.Dockerfile, in debian bookworm arm64 with ffmpeg in /opt/ffmpeg)

configurePresets.name: yandex-midi
configurePresets.description: midi's audiod (deploy/builder/build-midi-audiod.sh, zig for glibc 2.30, in device.Dockerfile's midi-cross stage)

configurePresets.name: yandex-micro
configurePresets.description: micro's audiod (deploy/builder/device.Dockerfile's zig cross build): alsa, no airplay or soloist

configurePresets.name: vk-capsula-mini
configurePresets.description: the vk capsula mini's audiod (deploy/builder/build-vk-audiod.sh, zig for aarch64 glibc 2.28, in device.Dockerfile's vk-cross stage): no soloist, no airplay, the keyword engine on tensorflow lite micro

configurePresets.name: sim
configurePresets.description: the sim image's audiod (device/Dockerfile.sim): file backends, soloist unjailed, airplay's bus and a fake shairport without avahi or nqptp

configurePresets.name: sim-tv
configurePresets.description: the screen sim's audiod (planned): file backends, libairplay, no url source

configurePresets.name: rpi
configurePresets.description: the pi's audiod (deploy/builder/rpi.Dockerfile): alsa on hdmi or bluealsa, libairplay on trixie's openssl, libplist and avahi-client, no url source

configurePresets.name: android-tv
configurePresets.description: the android app's audiod (stream F; android/native builds it in process with these options, the airplay receiver off until audiod has its libairplay side): aaudio, libairplay on build/libairplay/android-armeabi-v7a's openssl and libplist, no url source, soloist plain (unjailed, through the runtime's loader: the app ships the arm64 runtime in its data); needs ANDROID_NDK_ROOT (ndk r29) and the dependencies' prefix in CADENCE_ANDROID_DEPS
